messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
#include <queue>
#include <stack>
#include <functional>
#define INF 999999999
#define ms(a, x) memset(a, x, sizeof(a))

using namespace std;

bool cmd(int a, int b)
{
	return a > b;
}

int main()
{
	int n, a[110] = { 0 };
	cin >> n;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
	{
		cin >> a[i];
	}
	int t;
	cin >> t;
	sort(a, a + n);
	int num = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
	{
		int count = 0, last = a[i] + t;
		for (int j = i; j < n; j++)
		{
			if (a[j] >= a[i] && a[j] <= last)
			{
				count++;
			}
		}
		if (count > num)
		{
			num = count;
		}
	}
	cout << num;
}
